title: Design System: KBK Informasi discovery surfaces

motion.name: hero-cycle

motion.name: cluster-marquee

narrative.overview: The supplied grayscale wireframes govern the landing and event surfaces. This is an intentional low-fidelity phase, not a replacement institutional palette for all routes. Other pages retain their existing blue/yellow system.
keyCharacteristics: Distinct editorial, event and news layouts
dos: Keep database content and labeled preview fixtures distinct.
Keep this system scoped to landing and events.
donts: Do not infer final brand colors or a new content model from the wireframe.
